issues.reason: A generic denial over a bare kind-denoting subject is 'the same distributing rule at strength 0.0' ('Owls don't migrate'), and nothing licenses a bare kind in the Agent slot of a minted event witness — the bare-class-symbol licence is reserved for non-specific / generic OBJECTS ('cooked dinner') — so the flat bundle records a single-event denial in place of the generic one the sentence makes.

gaps_confirmed: A two-bare-kind clause carrying a domain adjunct: the relational-generic trigger (bare plural or mass on each side) selects the opaque kind-relation `(Replace salt sea_water)`, which has no slot for 'in distillation', so that trigger and the never-silently-drop-a-restriction rule pull in opposite directions with no stated tie-breaker.
defect_summary: The compliant form is the strength-0.0 distributing rule over the bare kind — `(Implication (Member $x salt) (And (Member (sk_replace $x) replace) (Agent (sk_replace $x) $x) (Theme (sk_replace $x) sea_water) (In (sk_replace $x) distillation))) (STV 0.0 0.9)` — which is also the only stated route that can carry the domain adjunct.
notes: The `In` oblique for the framing PP, the bare-kind `sea_water` Theme, the definitional `sea_water` genus kept at top level outside the denial, and the absence of a QuantifierPhrase (plain 'not' takes none) are all correct.
